residuals: This is a FAST/BATCH downstream measurement. No BOUNDARY or SEAL evidence was generated: no Miri, sanitizers, dudect/ctgrind, FFI negative controls or caller-closure audit.
The honest yield is 2 new L7 families from 35 admissions (njs and casync). 33 families are recorded at their exact build/runtime level; no level was fabricated and no missing count was padded.
The court container's documented writable host bind mount (/work) remains a standing infrastructure task; docker/ was not changed.
The S53 build changed forensics/tools/downstream_build_link.py and forensics/tools/downstream_runtime.py plus the two measured atlases; src/ was not changed.
The remaining 723 no-recipe rows keep S52's SOURCE-UNREACHABLE classification; their selection exclusions are not a new safety claim.
non_claims: Exactly 35 families were added, not more; the exact added L7 count is 2 (njs and casync).
A fresh candidate-bound L7 count is not safety or cryptographic evidence (AGENTS.md section 8).
No IMPLEMENTATION divergence was established in S53; every non-L7 outcome is HARNESS, ENVIRONMENT or SOURCE-UNREACHABLE with the evidence recorded above.
No family graduates to SAFE_COMPATIBLE in S53.
